name: Full Stack (Frontend + Backend)
postStartCommand: sh -c 'gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then echo "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | gh auth login --with-token && echo "gh: authenticated via GITHUB_TOKEN" || echo "gh: GITHUB_TOKEN auth failed - run gh auth login manually"; else echo "gh: GITHUB_TOKEN not set on host - run gh auth login manually"; fi; }'
postCreateCommand: npm install -g opencode-ai && cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
